AuthorGram+ is a privacy-focused Telegram client by AuthorChe for secure communication, flexible controls and convenient everyday use.
AuthorGram+ is based on Telegram for Android and includes GPL-compatible open-source work used by AuthorGram. These names are shown only for proper legal attribution of open-source code.
